merge.why: Provisional Gods keep-policy ruling: each is a one-of Replenish payload and the opening hand usually wants to discard it. The exact God matters after the graveyard is stocked, but this first bucket trial tests whether opening-hand keep decisions can treat these thirteen as payload count. Compare with a split policy before final adoption.

Provisional K=17 trial requested for the first feasible exhaustive mulligan table. Both are unique Purphoros payoffs; one grants haste and the other deals entry damage, so compare this merge against a K=18 split before final adoption.
